scripts.docs:deploy: pnpm docs:build && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/docs/dist --project-name=fewui-docs --branch=main
scripts.kit-docs:deploy: pnpm kit-docs:build && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/kit-docs/.vitepress/dist --project-name=fewui-kit --branch=main
scripts.www:deploy: pnpm www:build && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/www/dist --project-name=fewui-www --branch=main
scripts.deploy:pages: pnpm docs:deploy && pnpm www:deploy && pnpm kit-docs:deploy
